scripts.text:
[Nidhogg]
This place is too dangerous for you to explore alone.
Please form a party and come with your comrades.
scripts.translation:
[尼德霍格]
这个地方对你来说太危险了，不适合独自探索。
请组建队伍，和你的同志们一起来。

scripts.text:
[Nidhogg]
Only party leaders can control access to the Temple of the Demon God.
It's to ensure the safety of the entire Expedition. Please let your leader talk to me instead.
scripts.translation:
[尼德霍格]
只有队伍的首领才能控制进入恶魔神殿的权限。
这是为了确保整个远征队的安全。请让你的首领来和我对话。

scripts.text:
[Nidhogg]
I'm sorry, but you can't enter this place without approval from the Commander.
You must be on the quest to subjugate the Demon God to enter this place.
scripts.translation:
[尼德霍格]
很抱歉，没有指挥官的批准，你不能进入这个地方。
你必须拥有“讨伐恶魔神”的任务才能进入此地。

scripts.text:
[Nidhogg]
Please go to Commander Hiva Agip and receive the Demon God Subjugation quest.
scripts.translation:
[尼德霍格]
请去找指挥官希瓦·阿吉普，接受“讨伐恶魔神”的任务。

scripts.text:
[Nidhogg]
I've been waiting for you, hero-in-waiting. 
Let me guide you to the depth of the temple where Morroc lies in wait.
scripts.translation:
[尼德霍格]
我一直在等你，未来的英雄。
让我指引你前往神殿深处，那里有梦罗克在等待。

scripts.text:
[Nidhogg]
This tree is the spitting image of Yggdrasil.
I just hope Morroc is not intent on what I fear most.
Through this tree the door is opened.
scripts.translation:
[尼德霍格]
这棵树简直就是世界树尤克特拉希尔的翻版。
我只希望梦罗克没有像我最害怕的那样行事。
透过这棵树，门就会打开。

scripts.text:
[Nidhogg]
I can sense that
this tree is generating mana at certain intervals as if it's breathing.
I'm going to catch a moment between its breaths to open up a path for you. Are you ready?
scripts.translation:
[尼德霍格]
我能感觉到，
这棵树正以某种间隔产生魔力，就像在呼吸一样。
我会在它呼吸的间隙抓住时机，为你打开一条道路。你准备好了吗？

scripts.text: Enter now.
scripts.translation: 现在进入

scripts.text: Do not enter.
scripts.translation: 不要进入

scripts.text:
[Nidhogg]
Okay.
I understand if you need time.
Take your time. I can wait as long as you want me to.
scripts.translation:
[尼德霍格]
好的。
如果你需要时间，我理解。
慢慢来，我可以等你，多久都行。

scripts.text:
[Nidhogg]
Just wait a while, and the entrance will open.
Enter through the tree.
Don't be scared, even though it's not an ordinary tree.
scripts.translation:
[尼德霍格]
请稍等片刻，入口就会打开。
穿过这棵树进入。
别害怕，虽然它不是一棵普通的树。

scripts.text:
[Nidhogg]
You have eliminated the God of Despair!?
I can only say that his ambition was too big...
Always talk about creating a new world and becoming a god...
scripts.translation:
[尼德霍格]
你消灭了绝望之神！？
我只能说他的野心太大了...
总是谈论创造新世界和成为神...

scripts.text:
[Nidhogg]
But seriously, he didn't create anything at all!
Abandon the body that used to be a demon, and the appearance after rebirth is just imitating the god...
scripts.translation:
[尼德霍格]
但说真的，他什么也没创造出来！
抛弃了曾经作为恶魔的身体，重生后的样子只是在模仿神...

scripts.text:
[Nidhogg]
The result is just what a human looks like,
He can't escape the so-called god frame,
...you can only say that you are eating bad luck!
scripts.translation:
[尼德霍格]
结果看起来就像个普通人，
他无法摆脱所谓的“神”的外壳，
...只能说他是自讨苦吃！

scripts.text:
[Nidhogg]
I will give you approval for the quest, and you can report to the commander.
Thank you!
scripts.translation:
[尼德霍格]
我会批准你的任务，你可以去见指挥官了。
谢谢！

scripts.text:
[Nidhogg]
I'm sorry, but you can't enter this place without approval from the Commander.
You must be on the quest to subjugate the Demon God to enter this place.
scripts.translation:
[尼德霍格]
很抱歉，没有指挥官的批准，你不能进入这个地方。
你必须拥有“讨伐恶魔神”的任务才能进入此地。

scripts.text:
[Nidhogg]
Please go to Commander Hiva Agip and receive the 'Demon God Subjugation' quest.
scripts.translation:
[尼德霍格]
请去找指挥官希瓦·阿吉普，接受“讨伐恶魔神”的任务。

scripts.text:
You touched the tree and felt a strange flow of mana.
Perhaps the flow of mana will guide you to the depth of the temple.
scripts.translation:
你触摸了那棵树，感觉到一股奇异的魔力流动。
也许这股魔力流动会指引你前往神殿深处。

scripts.text: Enter.
scripts.translation: 进入

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text:
[Nidhogg]
Okay.
I understand if you need time.
Take your time. I can wait as long as you want me to.
scripts.translation:
[尼德霍格]
好的。
如果你需要时间，我理解。
慢慢来，我可以等你，多久都行。

scripts.text:
[Nidhogg]
This place is too dangerous for you to explore alone.
Please form a party and come with your comrades.
scripts.translation:
[尼德霍格]
这个地方对你来说太危险了，不适合独自探索。
请组建队伍，和你的同志们一起来。

scripts.text:
[Nidhogg]
No entry permission has been issued under the name of your party.
Please let your party leader submit an entry request, and I'll open the gate to the temple.
scripts.translation:
[尼德霍格]
你的队伍名下没有发出进入许可。
请让你的队伍首领提交进入申请，我会打开通往神殿的大门。

scripts.text:
[Nidhogg]
You are to comply with the rules set by the Expedition.
It's for everyone's safety.
scripts.translation:
[尼德霍格]
你必须遵守远征队制定的规则。
这是为了大家的安全。

scripts.text:
[Nidhogg]
Um...how could this happen... the flow of magic power becomes unstable,
It hurts my brain, this is the gap I finally made...
may not be able to enter at the moment...
scripts.translation:
[尼德霍格]
嗯...怎么会这样...魔力流动变得不稳定，
我的脑子好痛，这是我终于造成的缺口...
可能暂时无法进入...

scripts.text:
[Nidhogg]
You have eliminated the God of Despair!?
I can only say that his ambition was too big...
Always talk about creating a new world and becoming a god...
scripts.translation:
[尼德霍格]
你消灭了绝望之神！？
我只能说他的野心太大了...
总是谈论创造新世界和成为神...

scripts.text:
[Nidhogg]
But seriously, he didn't create anything at all!
Abandon the body that used to be a demon, and the appearance after rebirth is just imitating the god...
scripts.translation:
[尼德霍格]
但说真的，他什么也没创造出来！
抛弃了曾经作为恶魔的身体，重生后的样子只是在模仿神...

scripts.text:
[Nidhogg]
The result is just what a human looks like,
He can't escape the so-called god frame,
...you can only say that you are eating bad luck!
scripts.translation:
[尼德霍格]
结果看起来就像个普通人，
他无法摆脱所谓的“神”的外壳，
...只能说他是自讨苦吃！

scripts.text:
[Nidhogg]
I will give you approval for the quest, and you can report to the commander.
Thank you!
scripts.translation:
[尼德霍格]
我会批准你的任务，你可以去见指挥官了。
谢谢！

scripts.text:
[Ahat]
Welcome
to the Temple of the Demon God.
It's my honor to be your host today.
scripts.translation:
[阿哈特]
欢迎来到
恶魔神殿。
很荣幸今天能接待你们。

scripts.text:
[Ahat]
So, you've come.
Gosh, you're so persistent.
Hah hah, are you surprised to see me here?
scripts.translation:
[阿哈特]
所以，你来了。
天哪，你真是执着。
哈哈，看到我在这里感到惊讶吗？

scripts.text:
[Ahat]
Didn't you expect this at all?
Why don't I introduce myself officially?
I'm Ahat, the first servant of the Demon God.
scripts.translation:
[阿哈特]
你完全没料到吧？
那就让我正式介绍一下自己吧。
我是阿哈特，恶魔之神的头号仆从。

scripts.text:
[Ahat]
Well, well, maybe I forfeit my life today.
Don't look at me like that. Everything is as planned.
scripts.translation:
[阿哈特]
哎呀，看来我今天要交代在这里了。
别用那种眼神看我，一切都在计划之中。

scripts.text:
[Ahat]
My master wishes for Shnaim and I to put you to the test.
To see if you deserve to be our guests.
scripts.translation:
[阿哈特]
我的主人希望我和施奈姆来考验一下你们。
看看你们是否配得上成为我们的客人。

scripts.text:
[Ahat]
If you think you've come this far on your own,
you're mistaken.
scripts.translation:
[阿哈特]
如果你以为能靠自己的力量走到这一步，
那你就大错特错了。

scripts.text:
[Ahat]
Everything is as the Master has planned.
For now, let's see if you can open this door.
scripts.translation:
[阿哈特]
一切都在师父的计划之中。
现在，让我们看看你能不能打开这扇门。

scripts.text: Only party leaders can perform this event.
scripts.translation: 只有队伍首领才能执行此活动。

scripts.text: If you want to activate the soul globes, you need Shnaim's soul.
scripts.translation: 若要激活灵魂球，需要施奈姆的灵魂。

scripts.text: Inject {0}'s soul into the empty soul globe.
scripts.translation: 将{0}的灵魂注入空的灵魂球。

scripts.text: Successfully activated {0}'s soul globe.
scripts.translation: 成功激活了{0}的灵魂球。

scripts.text:
[Boy]
You insignificant creature.
How dare you lay a hand on a god-in-waiting?!
scripts.translation:
[男孩]
你这卑微的生物。
竟敢对即将成神者动手？！

scripts.text:
[Boy]
First, let me applaud you for coming this far.
You've been a good pawn.
scripts.translation:
[男孩]
首先，我要为你们能走到这一步鼓掌。
你们是很好的棋子。

scripts.text: What are you talking about?
scripts.translation: 你在说什么？

scripts.text:
[Boy]
I've been waiting for this day.
To get out of that corner of the demon world and rule the entire universe.
scripts.translation:
[男孩]
我等待这一天已经很久了。
为了走出恶魔世界的一角，统治整个宇宙。

scripts.text:
[Boy]
To achieve that, I realized I must abandon my old body.
So I died--well, I let you kill me.
scripts.translation:
[男孩]
为了达成目标，我意识到必须抛弃旧的身体。
所以我死了——好吧，是你们杀了我。

scripts.text:
[Boy]
Death is an inevitable step to take before rebirth.
So I'm reborn--again, you brought me back.
scripts.translation:
[男孩]
死亡是重生前必经的一步。
所以我重生了——又是你们把我带回来的。

scripts.text:
[Boy]
All this has been arranged so that I could be reborn as God.
scripts.translation:
[男孩]
这一切都是为了让我重生为神而安排的。

scripts.text:
[Morroc]
That's right, you foolish humans!
I died once, so that I could circle around the world and embrace it in my arms.
I've been reborn to engulf this world.
scripts.translation:
[梦罗克]
没错，愚蠢的人类！
我死过一次，是为了环游世界并拥抱它。
我重生是为了吞噬这个世界。

scripts.text:
[Morroc]
I'll create a new world and become its Creator.
Let me ask you, the first creatures that have stepped into my newborn land.
scripts.translation:
[梦罗克]
我将创造一个新世界，并成为它的创造者。
让我问问你们，这些踏入我新生土地的第一个生物。

scripts.text:
[Morroc]
How'd you like to follow me and watch the birth of a new world?
scripts.translation:
[梦罗克]
你们愿意跟随我，见证新世界的诞生吗？

scripts.text:
[Loki]
You're helpless.
And disgusting.
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
你无能为力。
而且令人作呕。

scripts.text:
[Nidhogg]
You're with a mercenary.
Could you dismiss your current mercenary and hire me instead?
scripts.translation:
[尼德霍格]
你正在雇佣一名佣兵。
能否解雇当前的佣兵，改雇我？

scripts.text:
[Nidhogg]
I already assisted you once.
Please be careful!
scripts.translation:
[尼德霍格]
我已经帮过你一次了。
请小心！

scripts.text:
[Nidhogg]
{0},
allow me to aid you in this battle.
scripts.translation:
[尼德霍格]
{0}，
请允许我在这场战斗中助你一臂之力。

scripts.text:
[Nidhogg]
My duty as the guardian isn't over yet.
scripts.translation:
[尼德霍格]
我作为守护者的职责尚未结束。

scripts.text: ^4d4dffGuardian Nidhogg has joined your party.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff守护者尼德霍格加入了你的队伍。^000000

scripts.text:
[Nidhogg]
That was a tough battle.
This may not be good enough, but I hope it'll help your growth.
scripts.translation:
[尼德霍格]
这是一场艰苦的战斗。
虽然这可能还不够，但我希望它能助你的成长。

scripts.text: ^4d4dffGuardian Nidhogg has rewarded you with a large amount of EXP for defeating Brinaranea.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff守护者尼德霍格因你击败了巴利纳拉雷亚，奖励了你大量经验值。^000000

scripts.text:
[Nidhogg]
Can this dreadful place compete with the Frost of the Genesis?
I can't say.
He's created nothing on his own. How did he convince himself to think that he could be a creator?
scripts.translation:
[尼德霍格]
这可怕的地方能与创世的寒霜相提并论吗？
我无法断言。
他从未独自创造过任何东西。他是如何说服自己，认为自己能成为创造者的？

scripts.text:
[Nidhogg]
That was a tough battle.
This may not be good enough, but I hope it'll help your growth.
scripts.translation:
[尼德霍格]
这是一场艰苦的战斗。
虽然这可能还不够，但我希望它能助你的成长。

scripts.text: ^4d4dffGuardian Nidhogg has rewarded you with a large amount of EXP for defeating Brinaranea.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff守护者尼德霍格因你击败了巴利纳拉雷亚，奖励了你大量经验值。^000000

scripts.text:
[Morroc]
You're good.
Can you take on the wolf that swallowed the sun?
scripts.translation:
[梦罗克]
你很强。
你能对付吞下太阳的那只狼吗？

scripts.text:
[Morroc]
If you can't handle him, then you can't handle a god now, can you?
scripts.translation:
[梦罗克]
如果你连他都对付不了，那你现在也对付不了神，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Morroc]
I'll watch you. Mwa hah hah!
scripts.translation:
[梦罗克]
我会看着你的。哇哈哈！

scripts.text: It can be used to block the flow of lava using a Frost Crystal.
scripts.translation: 可以使用万年冰霜来阻挡熔岩的流动。

scripts.text: Use a Frost Crystal
scripts.translation: 使用万年冰霜

scripts.text: Do not use a Frost Crystal
scripts.translation: 不使用万年冰霜

scripts.text: It can be used to block the flow of lava using a Frost Crystal.
scripts.translation: 可以使用万年冰霜来阻挡熔岩的流动。

scripts.text: Use a Frost Crystal
scripts.translation: 使用万年冰霜

scripts.text: Do not use a Frost Crystal
scripts.translation: 不使用万年冰霜

scripts.text:
[Nidhogg]
Good job, again.
This may not be good enough, but I hope it'll help your growth.
scripts.translation:
[尼德霍格]
干得好，再次。
虽然这可能还不够，但我希望它能助你的成长。

scripts.text: ^4d4dffGuardian Nidhogg has rewarded you with a large amount of EXP for defeating Muspellskoll.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff守护者尼德霍格因你击败了穆希贝斯寇，奖励了你大量经验值。^000000

scripts.text:
[Nidhogg]
Skoll... Skoll and Haati...
Everything in here is a mere copy of that in the outside world.
He's not a creator.
scripts.translation:
[尼德霍格]
斯库尔...斯库尔和哈提...
这里的一切不过是外界事物的拙劣复制品。
他不是创造者。

scripts.text:
[Nidhogg]
Good job, again.
This may not be good enough, but I hope it'll help your growth.
scripts.translation:
[尼德霍格]
干得好，再次。
虽然这可能还不够，但我希望它能助你的成长。

scripts.text: ^4d4dffGuardian Nidhogg has rewarded you with a large amount of EXP for defeating Muspellskoll.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff守护者尼德霍格因你击败了穆希贝斯寇，奖励了你大量经验值。^000000

scripts.text:
[Nidhogg]
I don't know what to say.
We stopped the god-in-waiting.
We accomplished our goal.
But I'm still unnerved.
scripts.translation:
[尼德霍格]
我不知该说什么。
我们阻止了那位准神。
我们达成了目标。
但我依然感到不安。

scripts.text:
[Nidhogg]
This world is created in the mind of Morroc's.
He'll live forever in this garden he couldn't finish.
scripts.translation:
[尼德霍格]
这个世界诞生于梦罗克的脑海中。
他将永远生活在他未能完成的这座花园里。

scripts.text:
[Nidhogg]
He probably doesn't know his body is destroyed forever.
He was far too ambitious, even for him.
He wanted to create a new world and become its creator,
scripts.translation:
[尼德霍格]
他大概不知道自己的身体已永远毁灭。
对他而言，这也太过野心勃勃了。
他想创造一个新世界并成为其创造者，

scripts.text:
[Nidhogg]
but he couldn't create anything on his own.
He abandoned his Demon body, just to become a mere facsimile of an existing god.
scripts.translation:
[尼德霍格]
但他无法独自创造任何东西。
他抛弃了自己的恶魔之躯，只为成为现有神明的拙劣仿制品。

scripts.text:
[Nidhogg]
He took the shape of a man.
He wasn't creative enough to reinvent the concept of God.
He was a paradox.
scripts.translation:
[尼德霍格]
他化作了人形。
他缺乏足够的创造力去重新定义“神”的概念。
他本身就是一个悖论。

scripts.text:
[Nidhogg]
Now we need to get out of this trap in time and end; to reality.
This world only exists in the Demon God's mind. The same day repeats forever.
scripts.translation:
[尼德霍格]
现在我们需要及时逃离这个陷阱，回到现实。
这个世界只存在于魔神的心中。同一天会永远重复。

scripts.text:
[Nidhogg]
Everyone who enters this world will be dragged into the same loop.
In that sense, he succeeded in making his own world.
scripts.translation:
[尼德霍格]
每一个进入这个世界的人都会被卷入同样的循环。
从这个意义上说，他成功创造了自己的世界。

scripts.text:
[Nidhogg]
Today's despair will repeat day after day.
Even though we know this, we'll come back to walk the same path again. I hope I'll be able to fight by you every time...
scripts.translation:
[尼德霍格]
今日的绝望将日复一日地重演。
尽管我们知晓这一切，我们仍会回来，再次踏上同样的道路。我希望每次都能与你并肩作战...

scripts.text:
[Nidhogg]
I've talked too much. The Commander must be waiting. Let me validate your feat, so you can report to him.
You did great today.
scripts.translation:
[尼德霍格]
我话太多了。指挥官一定在等着。让我确认你的功绩，以便你向他汇报。
你今天表现得非常出色。

scripts.text:
[Nidhogg]
...It feels like things are not over yet,
This is very close to Morroc's spiritual world,
He should be here to keep thinking about the past!
scripts.translation:
[尼德霍格]
...感觉事情还没有结束。
这里非常接近梦罗克的精神世界，
他应该在这里，继续沉溺于对过去的思考！

scripts.text: Exit.
scripts.translation: 离开

scripts.text:
[Nidhogg]
Of course. You must be exhausted.
Let me send you to the other members of your Expedition, free of charge.
scripts.translation:
[尼德霍格]
当然。你一定很疲惫了。
让我免费送你回到你的远征队成员那里。

scripts.text: What?
scripts.translation: 什么？

scripts.text: Wrong.
scripts.translation: 错了。

scripts.text: What Boss?
scripts.translation: 哪个Boss？

scripts.text: Brinaranea
